requirements.requirement: The system must expose a callable normalization interface accessible via the Evaluate Care facade.
The system must accept normalization requests conforming to the schema defined in EVAL-NORM-SCHEMA-001.
The system must return normalized outputs strictly in the standardized scale defined by the normalization schema.
The system must invoke the normalization engine from EVAL-NORM-LOGIC-001 for all valid requests.
The system must support batch normalization of multiple measures within a single request.
The system must return a consistent response structure including normalized values, applied method, and metadata for each measure.
The system must ensure compatibility of the normalization API response with downstream scoring engines for providers and clinical trials.
The system must validate all incoming requests and reject those with missing required fields.
The system must return a structured error response when validation fails, including error code and message.
The system must handle unsupported measure types by returning a defined error without invoking the normalization engine.
The system must log normalization requests and responses for traceability within the Evaluate Care workflow.
The system must ensure idempotent behavior such that identical inputs produce identical normalized outputs.
The system must enforce that normalization is executed prior to scoring within the Evaluate Care facade flow.
The system must gracefully handle internal normalization engine failures by returning a standardized error response without exposing internal stack traces.
